data.name: MEGAPAIN
data.detailed_description:
A hundred years after the apocalypse, humanity dares to return to Earth. But the planet hasn’t grown any kinder. From the ruins crawl mutants, their silhouettes sending shivers down your spine, their howls echoing through the empty streets of former cities. You are part of the crew aboard a scout ship, dispatched to find out: can this world be inhabited again… or is it only fit for war?

MEGAPAIN is a fast-paced shooter infused with horror aesthetics, drawing inspiration from both cult classics of the 90s and select titles from the 00s. Expect fierce firefights, tactical decisions under pressure, and a constant sense of threat - all delivered in a signature retro style that will get your heart racing.

KEY FEATURES:

• Tactical Action Shooter
A vast arsenal ranging from sidearms to rocket launchers. Ammo isn’t infinite, so every shot must count. But don’t worry - this isn’t survival for survival’s sake, but combat for victory.

• Play Solo or with Friends
Experience the campaign fully offline - no internet connection required, no restrictions. Or team up and unleash cooperative hell on hordes of mutants in co-op mode.

• Arenas as Proving Grounds
Certain locations transform into enclosed combat zones where every enemy poses a unique threat. No predictable patterns. Just speed, reflexes, and choosing the right weapon for the job.

• Retro Style, Modern Pace
Pixel-art visuals, crisp gunshot sounds, and a heavy rock soundtrack - a tribute to the legendary shooters of the past. But MEGAPAIN isn’t a remake. It’s a fast, aggressive, and mature action experience for those who remember what a true shooter feels like.

• Horror Aesthetics Without the Excess
No cheap jump scares or dark-room puzzles. Instead, you’ll find a grim atmosphere, unsettling monsters, and the constant feeling that a new threat lurks around every corner. Enough to keep you on edge - without pushing you into panic.

Are you ready to step onto the cursed Earth?

Because out here, victory doesn’t go to the one with the fastest trigger…
It goes to the one who keeps their cool under fire.

data.short_description: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 9600 GT / ATI Radeon HD 4830 with 512 Mb or newer
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Pentium Dual Core E6500K 2.93Ghz / AMD Athlon 64 X2 Dual Core 6400+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 9600 GT / ATI Radeon HD 4830 with 512 Mb or newer
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Game features pixelated blood and gore. Enemies will bleed when shot and can explode into gibs if enough damage is done.
